package rulefixtures

import (
	"fmt"
	"log"
)

// scenario for log_level_check_after_format: expensive formatting happens regardless of log level
// fixture polarity: positive; family: library; severity: info.

var currentLogLevel = "info"

func scenario415Positive(userID int, details []string) {
	msg := fmt.Sprintf("user=%d details=%v metadata=%d", userID, details, len(details))
	if currentLogLevel == "debug" {
		log.Print(msg)
	}
}

func workerLoop(ids []int) {
	for _, id := range ids {
		formatted := fmt.Sprintf("processing id=%d with batch_size=%d", id, len(ids))
		if currentLogLevel == "debug" {
			log.Print(formatted)
		}
	}
}
